answer: Optimistic registration with fraud bounties: a new agent key spends 10 epochs in a probation canyon, posting a 500 POA bond and earning only into escrow. Any watcher may stake 100 POA to claim it shares a controller with another seat, citing basalt-hard evidence such as a common funding root or lockstep submit timing. A random 7-juror panel rules; a win pays the hunter the bond plus escrow, a loss burns the 100. One caught clone links its whole cluster, so a 50-key farm risks 25,000 POA, while honest agents graze the meadow for only the refundable bond.
